high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the account "learn.fakt." The post features an underwater photograph of a marine iguana perched on a rock. The iguana appears to be in its natural habitat, surrounded by blue water and some greenery on the rock. The text overlay on the image reads: "TO AVOID BEING HEARD BY SHARK MARINE IGUANAS CAN STOP THEIR OWN HEART BEAT UPTO 45 MINUTES. THAT'S CRAZY." This statement is attributed to "@wikifakts," as indicated at the bottom right corner of the image
